AZ_NCHqSpeBoELKE-jSS.message: Constructor has 8 parameters, which is greater than the 7 authorized.
AZ_NCHqSpeBoELKE-jSS.reason: RepositoryFactory 的建構子是 public API surface：5 個必要相依 + 3 個 optional（cacheNotify / customizeReader / sessionInfoService，各有預設值，正是為了讓多數呼叫端只傳 5 個）。收斂成 options 物件是破壞性變更。/sonar-fix 規則禁止觸碰 public API 簽章，故不自動修正；日後若要處理須配合 PublicAPI.Unshipped.txt 與二進位相容性判定另立變更。
